content: GitHub Pages had a confirmed bug (community discussion #178318) where range requests combined with accept-encoding: gzip returned an invalid partial gzip stream, breaking Firefox range-request decompression for files like Parquet; Chrome/Safari were unaffected since they don't request gzip with Range. Fixed via mime-db marking parquet as incompressible (merged ~Jan 2026) plus a Firefox-side fix; confirmed working by March 2026 but shows GitHub Pages range-request behavior is not fully guaranteed/stable over time.
